title: CoordUnleash
description: Removes the vanilla teleportation coordinate limits. Compatible with FartherLands for extreme exploration!
body:
CoordUnleash is a lightweight mod designed to completely remove the hardcoded 30,000,000 coordinate boundaries from Minecraft's teleportation and command systems. 

* **Limitless Teleportation:** Use the `/tp` command to travel to billions or quadrillions of blocks without being artificially stopped by the game's command parsers.
* **World Border Bypass:** Completely disables the physical collision and mathematical clamping of the vanilla world border.
* **Universal Compatibility:** Built using MixinExtras (`@WrapOperation`), ensuring this mod can stack safely with other mods that modify coordinate limitations.

**FartherLands Compatibility:**
This mod works flawlessly alongside the [FartherLands](https://modrinth.com/mod/fartherlands) mod! 
* If you want to explore the extreme limits of the game (beyond 33.554.432 blocks), it is **highly recommended** to use both mods together. 
* CoordUnleash will handle bypassing the `/tp` command parser limits, while FartherLands will handle the complex chunk memory and generation bypasses required to keep the server stable at those extreme distances.
